title: findbtc hits.jsonl line (v1)
description: One JSONL line of `findbtc -json` output: a single Detection. The same schema covers the raw, filesystem-guided (-fs), and owner-reveal (--reveal) variants; variant-only fields are optional and documented per property. Within v1 only additive, backwards-compatible changes are allowed (new optional properties, new enum values); any removal, rename, or type change requires a new schema version. See docs/HITS_SCHEMA.md.

description.description: Human-readable label for the matched trace.

needle.description: Machine-readable detector label (e.g. crypted_key, wif, bip39-12, eth-keystore).

offset.description: Absolute byte offset of the needle within target.

target.description: Scanned stream holding the hit (device path, image path, or archive member path).

match_length.description: Byte span of the hit (needle length or phrase span).

carve_path.description: Carved file for this hit; present only when carving is enabled (-extract-dir).

carve.description: Classification of the carved bytes; present only when carving succeeded.

hashes.description: Crack-ready password material extracted from the carve; present only when carving found usable mkey or keystore records.

words.description: Seed-phrase words for BIP39 hits; present only with owner opt-in (--reveal). Never present otherwise.

file_name.description: Filesystem entry holding the hit; present only for filesystem-guided (-fs) scans, never for raw scans.

salvage.description: Reassembled database pages from the carve; present only when salvage wrote a .salvage.db file.

fingerprint.description: Baseline key: v1/<relpath>/<needle>/<line-hash> on -walk sweeps, v1/history/<commit>/<path>/<needle>/<line-hash> on patch (-patch) scans; absent elsewhere.

commit.description: Enclosing commit sha; present only on patch (-patch) scans, and only for bytes inside a commit.

path.description: Enclosing repo-relative file; present only on patch (-patch) scans, and only for bytes inside a diff.

line.description: New-file line number holding the hit; present only on patch (-patch) scans, and only for added/context lines.

verified.description: True when a DER-family PEM body base64-decoded and parsed as a DER SEQUENCE. Structural offline check only: well-formed, not working; live verification is never performed.

class.description: Carve classifier label (sqlite, bdb, bbolt, gzip, zip, text, high-entropy, ...). Open set: new classes may appear within v1.

magic_offset.description: Carve-file offset of the identifying magic, if any.

entropy_bits.description: Shannon entropy of the carved bytes, in bits per byte.

hash.description: Cracker input string ($bitcoin$...); empty when only structured params are available.

salt_hex.description: KDF salt as hex, when applicable.

method.description: Bitcoin Core mkey derivation method, when applicable.

offset.description: Absolute offset of the source record in the scanned bytes.

path.description: Salvage output path; empty for analysis-only results.

complete.description: True when every page is present.

ordered.description: True when the image is in file order.

verdict.description: Structural open-prediction: valid (worth opening) or suspect (a lead, not a database). Absent on sidecars that predate validation.

reasons.description: Human-readable reasons for a suspect verdict; empty when valid.

pgno.description: Page number (BDB only; SQLite pages lack numbers).

offset.description: Absolute source offset of the page.
